turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start by telling me who decided that.
You didn't answer me. Who decided, and was Owen heard before that zero went in?
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.

11:31, 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58. Which night, and where is the document that shows it, because I'll read it myself before I take a teacher's word for it. And you still haven't told me who decided to enter that zero before anyone called me.
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?
You're leading me, Hale, and I've done this for twenty years. I don't do your arithmetic for you. Put the document in front of me with a date on it, or tell me why it isn't here.
What time is it now, by the way?
About twenty past four, and my call is at 4:40. You're spending my time on small talk while that zero sits in the gradebook. The date, and the document.
